topPRs.title: add prestates for kona-client/v1.2.10-rc.1
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Adds missing prestate entries to `validation/standard/standard-prestates.toml`.

The `preimage-reproducibility` CI job in ethereum-optimism/optimism detected 2 missing entries for `kona-client/v1.2.10-rc.1`:

- `cannon64-kona`: `0x03838c1ea9534e538a41bc8a8facbdd71e16724ab96af53532454ca3a82a2e30`
- `cannon64-kona-interop`: `0x03a5c095d40ab1a6631ea8f0e19efe3dc43b15c2832dba31533210075469f416`

## Verification

Hashes verified by rebuilding from the `kona-client/v1.2.10-rc.1` release tag locally — both rebuilt hashes matched the CI-reported hashes exactly.

## Entries Added

```toml
[[prestates."1.2.10-rc.1"]]
type="cannon64-kona"
hash="0x03838c1ea9534e538a41bc8a8facbdd71e16724ab96af53532454ca3a82a2e30"

[[prestates."1.2.10-rc.1"]]
type="cannon64-kona-interop"
hash="0x03a5c095d40ab1a6631ea8f0e19efe3dc43b15c2832dba31533210075469f416"
```
